fullPassage:
Stanford psychology professor Dr. Carol Dweck is the internationally recognized pioneer of the concept of "growth mindset" as a way to continually grow, learn, and persevere in our efforts.

(A) These kids end up taking on tougher things, and feel better about themselves. "Emphasizing effort gives a child a variable that they can control," Dweck has explained.

(B) In contrast, Dweck found, kids who are not praised for their smarts but for their effort develop what Dweck calls a "growth mindset." They learn that their effort is what led to their success, and if they continue to try, over time they'll improve and achieve more things.

(C) Dweck found that kids who are told they're "smart" actually underperform in future tasks, by choosing easier tasks to avoid evidence that they are not smart, which Dweck calls having a "fixed mindset."

칭찬은 아이의 성적에 아무런 영향을 미치지 않는다.
고정 마인드셋을 가진 아이들이 더 성공적이다.
노력에 대한 칭찬이 아이의 도전 정신과 성장을 촉진한다.

det.korean: 요약: 노력 칭찬 → 도전 정신 + 성장 촉진
det.analysis:
✅ ④ 정확한 요약
❌ ① 태어날 때부터 — 반대
❌ ② 영향 없음 — 반대
❌ ③ fixed가 더 성공 — 반대
det.tip: effort praise → growth mindset → challenge → improvement

questions.passage:
Stanford psychology professor Dr. Carol Dweck is the internationally recognized pioneer of the concept of "growth mindset" as a way to continually grow, learn, and persevere in our efforts.

(A) These kids end up taking on tougher things, and feel better about themselves. ____

(B) In contrast, Dweck found, kids who are not praised for their smarts but for their effort develop what Dweck calls a "growth mindset." They learn that their effort is what led to their success, and if they continue to try, over time they'll improve and achieve more things.

(C) Dweck found that kids who are told they're "smart" actually underperform in future tasks, by choosing easier tasks to avoid evidence that they are not smart, which Dweck calls having a "fixed mindset."
